newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia Motors '96 vehicle sales up 9.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kia Motors '96 vehicle sales up 9.6 pct.

text.p: Kia Motors Corp, South Korea's second largest car maker, said on Friday its vehicle sales rose 9.6 percent in 1996 to 781,250 units from 712,753 units in 1995.
Kia said in a statement exports totalled 322,850 units in 1996, up from 270,920 in 1995, while domestic sales amounted to 458,400 units, against 441,833.
"Exports of compact cars led the rise in last year's sales," said Kia spokesman Park Nam-ho.
Exports of passenger cars rose 20.1 percent in 1996 to 275,402 units from 229,370 in 1995.
The statement said vehicle sales in value terms rose 17.5 percent to 6.7 trillion won in 1996 from 5.7 trillion.
